note: Canonical game state-machine tree (one source, three views). done[app] = 0..1, how finished our 1:1 work is on that screen for that app (Qud = reference/how well we detect+drive it; Raves = render/impl fidelity). Edit freely; the cockpit reloads on file change. detect[app] recognises 'we are here' from live signals: game_live (Qud's 48710 bridge pushes a snapshot on connect ONLY when a game is actually running — the true menu-vs-in-game signal; the raw port is open even at the main menu, so it can't tell them apart), port (raw listener open = modded Qud alive), and ocr_any (case-insensitive substrings in an OCR of the window). A node matches when all its conditions hold; the DEEPEST match wins. Conditions needing OCR only match on an OCR-enabled poll, so cheap polls fall back to the coarsest ancestor.

children.label: Map Editor
children.note: Qud's map editor: an 80x25 cell canvas with a blueprint palette. WALKED LIVE at 1920x1080 on Lumpy (Qud 1.0.5, 2026-08-06) — every menu opened and captured; the command surface below is cross-checked against Overlay.MapEditor.MapEditorView by reflection, so it includes verbs that have no menu entry. LAYOUT: menu bar y=16 (File x46, Edit x112, Transform x203, View x293, Recent x369), title 'Map Editor' centred x959; canvas x50..1470 y208..872 (80x25 => cell ~17.7x26.6) with a green cell cursor; palette panel x1524..1920 — filter field 'Enter text...' at y4..30, a '[ ] In Use' toggle at y46 (right edge), the blueprint list with per-row tile icons, and readouts at the bottom: 'Mouse Position: X, Y' + 'Brush: <name>' (y695) and 'Selected Cell: X, Y|none' (y716); control hints bottom-left y1029/y1045. EXIT: File > Exit > confirm Yes returns to the TOOLKIT menu, and it leaves the legacy view string stuck at 'MapEditor' — trust `scene` (window-priority), not `view`. RAVES: MapEditorScreen.gd shipped — 95.16% content congruence at 1920x1080 on the first build, geometry MEASURED off the reference (menu text at x29/95/160/275/342, title x913, canvas 50,208 1420x664 = 80x25, palette pitch 24, readouts y688/y710, hints y1023/y1039). Working: the five menus with their verbatim items + hotkey column (Recent draws no panel when empty, matching Qud), the dotted 80x25 canvas with hover cursor, Shift+drag region select, Ctrl+click paint, Alt+click sample, Ctrl+Z undo, flips, Select All, the NorthSheva overlay toggle, the live palette from blueprints.json with filter + In Use, and all three readouts. TILES: painted cells now render Qud's REAL tile art — QudTiles recolours the exported grayscale mask with the blueprint's TileColor/DetailColor (BlueprintExporter gained tilecolor+detail; 1529 blueprints carry both), falling back to the render glyph, and a missing mask is fetched once via the new `wanttile` bridge command (only ~245 of ~5.2k tiles ship exported, so screens ask for what they draw). NOT DONE: no .rpm file I/O (New/Load/Save/Save As/Test inert) and no per-object context menu. TILE/PAINT PATH NOW VERIFIED LIVE (2026-08-07): Ctrl+click paints and the cell renders the blueprint's art — the glyph fallback confirmed on screen for a tile-less blueprint. The blocker was a highvisor bug, since fixed: a KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE modifier press is invisible to Godot (Unity polls global key state and accepts it; Godot tracks modifiers from key MESSAGES and wants the VK form), so hv now emits BOTH forms. Two Raves bugs were found by driving it: palette rows had zero width (a Control with custom_minimum_size (0,h) in a non-expanding VBox is unclickable, so the brush never set) and modifiers now come off the EVENT rather than Input.is_key_pressed. STILL OPEN on this leaf: no .rpm file I/O (New/Load/Save/Save As/Test inert), no per-object context menu, and a tile-BEARING blueprint has not been painted yet — only the glyph fallback is confirmed, so the mask recolour + wanttile fetch remain unproven.

children.label: Mouse + keyboard controls (drag verbs decoded from IL)
children.note: DECODED FROM IL + VERIFIED LIVE (2026-08-06). The on-screen hint 'Ctrl+Click-Paint from palette' is MISLEADING: painting is not a click. MapEditorView.OnClick performs NO modifier check at all — it raycasts a cell and calls OnCommand (selection only). All three drag verbs live in OnDragMove, each gated on a modifier read with Input.GetKey: SHIFT (LeftShift/RightShift) -> region select (sets isDragging/_dragStart, Rect min/max, RenderSelectionFrame); CTRL (LeftControl/RightControl) -> PAINT (raycast -> MapFileRegion.GetOrCreateCellAt -> MapFileCell.Objects.Add -> UndoStack.Push -> RenderMap); NO MODIFIER -> camera pan (LetterboxCamera.SetPositionImmediately). A click never moves the pointer, so it can never reach a drag handler — which is exactly why every Ctrl+Click attempt silently did nothing while the brush readout looked correct. DRIVING IT SYNTHETICALLY IS ONLY PARTLY SOLVED, and the honest numbers matter: Ctrl+drag DOES paint — objects appear on the canvas and the count climbs across runs — but it is INTERMITTENT, not reliable. Identical gestures at the same coordinates sometimes place an object (+57 px, one sprite) and sometimes place nothing. An earlier claim here that paint simply 'works' was too confident; it lands often enough to prove the verb, not often enough to script against yet. HOLD DURATION MEASURED: `hv drag --hold` sets the pause between press and first move. Longer is WORSE — at 0.5s and 1.2s a Ctrl+drag painted NOTHING in any trial, while the 0.08 default paints some of the time. A long press before movement stops registering as a drag at all. The default is therefore 0.08 and the flag exists to be lowered, not raised. MENU HOTKEYS from Update(), all Ctrl+<key>: Z undo, Y redo, N new, O open, S save, T test, A select-all, plus Ctrl+F1 overlay. UNDOCUMENTED FIND — Ctrl+C is handled in Update() and does Map/SelectedRegion -> MapFileRegion.GetRegion -> Clone -> SetBrush, i.e. it copies the SELECTED REGION into the brush as a multi-cell stamp. It appears in no menu and no hint text. RESOLUTION: rather than keep tuning injected input, the mod drives these verbs directly — MapEditorDriver.Paint/Select/Context (bridge `mapedit`). Reliable where synthetic input was intermittent or impossible, and it is the same precedent as EmbarkDriver.

children.label: Cell/region context menu (SOLVED — raised via the mod's MapEditorDriver)
children.note: SOLVED AND SEEN (2026-08-06). Trigger, from IL: MapEditorSelectedObjectsRow.OnPointerClick is `if (eventData.button != InputButton.Right) return; MapEditorView.instance.DisplayContextInRegion(this.bp);` — a RIGHT-CLICK ON A ROW of the selected-contents list, not on the canvas. Rows come from SelectedCellContentsView, filled by UpdateSelectedContents from HasSelectedRegion/SelectedRegion, so a region containing objects is the precondition. MENU CONTENTS, now captured rather than inferred: Set owner | Set part | Add string property | Add int property | Remove property — matching SetOwnerForContext / SetPartForContext / AddPropertyForContext / AddIntPropertyForContext / RemovePropertyForContext. (Flood, DeleteInRegion and ReplaceInRegion exist on MapEditorView but are NOT on this menu.) HOW TO DRIVE IT: synthetic mouse input cannot — see me_controls. The mod now drives the editor through its own API instead (mod/MapEditorDriver.cs, bridge command `mapedit`, the same skip-the-UI approach EmbarkDriver uses for chargen): {"name":"mapedit","do":"paint","x":21,"y":8,"bp":"Across1"} then {"do":"select","x":19,"y":7,"x2":22,"y2":9} then {"do":"context","x":20,"y":8}. Verified end to end: canvas gains the objects, the readout reads 'Selected Cell: 19, 7 - 23, 10', the contents rows populate, and the menu appears at x862..988 y490..574. `{"do":"state"}` logs a JSON readback for asserts. GOTCHA worth keeping: MapFile is NOT a MapFileRegion — the cell grid is MapFile.Cells, and the driver's first version logged 'no GetOrCreateCellAt on MapFile' until that was fixed.
